exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists as of 2026-10-14. Tailwind 3 and its ESLint plugin require this parser; moving to Tailwind 4 requires a separate CSS integration migration.
exceptions.mitigation: Only trusted repository content globs are processed. User HTML, regex and files never enter this dependency. Review untrusted PR changes in isolated CI without secrets; deeply nested glob patterns can still exhaust that job.
